latest_semantically_valid_feature_time_r: Until training/live feature parity is proven, use the latest completed UTC hour: floor(now_utc_hour) - 1 hour.
selected_production_feature_time_rule: Latest completed common provider UTC hour; do not include the in-progress provider hour.
target_contract: target_temperature_2h = same-location temperature exactly 2 chronological hours after feature_time
rationale: The current safe-hour + frozen T1H contract emits after its target has started. B preserves completed-hour inputs and gives an exact +2h target that remains 55 minutes ahead at H+5. A has positive lead in one probe but the frozen model was trained on Archive Best Match, live uses Forecast Best Match, and Archive training does not persist its selected model/vintage; wind-gust interval semantics are not proven equivalent. Do not claim frozen T1H reuse is a no-compromise design.

rejected_alternatives.reason: Time-causal in the probe but semantic compatibility with the frozen Archive-trained model is not established, including model-specific wind-gust time basis.
The conservative completed-hour + exact +2h option resolves target timing without relabeling; remaining feature-source pinning belongs in the explicitly named V1.1 modeling milestone.

next_milestone_requirements: Train the target at exactly feature_time + 2h.
Pin the predictor source/vintage to match live Forecast API semantics; Historical Forecast API is the documented aligned archive option.
Keep lags and trailing rolling windows causal and ending at the completed feature hour.
Only after a new frozen model passes validation, collect the prospective 24-hour cohort.
